name: Tiderock Companies Inc.
summary: Tiderock Companies Inc. functions as a real estate entity, offering expertise in investment, advisory services, and property development. The company's diverse development projects encompass residential apartments, commercial office spaces, hotels, student housing units, assisted living facilities, and academic buildings for higher education. Established in 2000, this Nevada-based firm, with its headquarters in Henderson, underwent a name change in September 2021, previously operating as iPure Labs, Inc.
